name: briefing_stop_and_shutdown_thread
description: Briefing::StopAndShutdownThread optionally waits for briefing input/advance completion, clears the thread run flag, waits for thread exit when needed, destroys the installed briefing runtime, clears the runtime pointer, and marks the briefing system inactive.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent Briefing runtime/source-cluster pass so the compiler-generated member-call and destructor/delete shape can be compared with class context.
The prior smoke described destructor slot dispatch and is stale after the production source stopped hand-authoring scalar-deleting destructor dispatch.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x404bd0 validates the optional wait-for-input loop, g_Briefing_ThreadRunFlag clear, Sleep wait for g_Briefing_ThreadExitedFlag, compiler scalar-deleting destructor call shape, runtime pointer clear, and system-active flag clear. The scalar-deleting destructor is provider glue, not authored source.

The native smoke verifies both immediate shutdown and wait-for-input paths, including runtime destruction, global thread/system flags, and runtime pointer clearing; delete-flag slot assertions are stale after the source-model cleanup.
